description: This file defines the class 'FieldStorageDefinitionListener' which reacts to CRUD operations on field storage definitions within Drupal's entity system, handling events such as create, update, and delete, and managing related repositories and cache clearing.

classes.name: FieldStorageDefinitionListener
classes.description: A class that listens to and reacts to CRUD operations on field storage definitions, dispatching events and managing related repositories.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes dependencies such as entity type manager, event dispatcher, schema repository, field manager, and deleted fields repository.

methods.name: onFieldStorageDefinitionCreate
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new field storage definition, updating schema repository, dispatching creation event, and clearing cache.

methods.name: onFieldStorageDefinitionUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates to existing field storage definitions, updating schema, dispatching update event, and clearing cache.

methods.name: onFieldStorageDefinitionDelete
methods.description: Handles deletion of field storage definitions, possibly storing deleted definitions if they contain data, updating schema, dispatching delete event, and clearing cache.
